title: Sonya M NDE 7263
content: After gurgling on the blood in my throat, I looked to the right, and the night sky opened up for me. I was transported into a peaceful, white light that made me feel like I was going home after a deployment. I saw images of my life all around me. When I was on the other side of the light, I saw such beauty. There were gardens upon gardens of colorful flowers, and the sky was white. I saw a person who led me further inside while saying to me, 'It is not your time; you have work left to do.' She said that I would survive what was happening. I will have babies and a new husband who would love me unconditionally. I questioned her about my having babies. Then I asked if I was supposed to be working as a massage therapist, which was my job at the time. She told me, 'No, you are supposed to be 'blank' (I can't remember). Then I asked, 'What is that?' She said, 'You'll know it when you're ready.' Then she told me that I was supposed to write. I told her, 'I'm not that creative.' She told me, 'You'll find it.' I was then led by the hand and asked if I wanted to meet Jesus. I asked, 'Am I worthy enough?' She took me by the hand and led me to him. I was bathed in the light that was radiating from his body. The next thing I saw was my estranged husband trying to snap my neck.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: The night sky 'opened up' and she was 'transported into a peaceful, white light.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A female-presenting person who led her, spoke with her, and offered to introduce her to Jesus.

environment.environment_other_detail: “gardens upon gardens of colorful flowers” and “the sky was white.”

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She was told “It is not your time; you have work left to do” and specifically “you were supposed to write.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: She was “gurgling on the blood in my throat” and later saw her estranged husband “trying to snap my neck.”

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Asked if she wanted to meet Jesus; was led to him and “bathed in the light” radiating from his body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Night sky opened → transported into white light (felt like going home) → saw images of life → emerged to a beautiful garden/white sky → guided conversation about not her time/work to do/future → led to meet Jesus and bathed in his light → then saw husband trying to snap her neck.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She compared the feeling of entering the light to “going home after a deployment.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It is not your time; you have work left to do.” / “She said that I would survive what was happening. I will have babies and a new husband who would love me unconditionally.” / “You'll know it when you're ready.” / “Then she told me that I was supposed to write.” / “I was then led by the hand and asked if I wanted to meet Jesus. I asked, 'Am I worthy enough?'” / “I was bathed in the light that was radiating from his body.”
